title: E9 simulation readiness checkpoint form B
instructions: This reciprocal readiness checkpoint is not the full mock. Apply the same reported timing and independent-work protocol to five fresh simulation decisions.

parts.prompt: A learner finishes Section 1 early and wants to spend the unused minutes on the essay. Which action preserves the rehearsal protocol?

options.text: Use Section 1's remaining time to review Section 1, stop at its boundary and begin a new 30-minute composition clock.
Transfer all remaining minutes to the essay.
Start the essay while continuing to change Section 1 answers.
Remove both clocks because the learner is ahead.

choice_rationales.A: This keeps the two reported sections separate.
choice_rationales.B: Time transfer changes the composition condition.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Unused time remains inside its section rather than changing the next section's limit.

parts.prompt: One banked-cloze gap has consumed too much time. What should the learner do?

options.text: Leave every later task unseen until this gap feels certain.
Enter the best supported option, flag the gap and continue, returning only if the section buffer permits.
Open a dictionary for confirmation.
End the simulation and count the gap as the final result.

choice_rationales.A: Unlimited time on one gap damages whole-section coverage.
choice_rationales.B: Commit–flag–move preserves a response and a possible return path.
choice_rationales.C: A dictionary changes the independent conditions.
choice_rationales.D: One difficult gap should not erase evidence from the remaining paper.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: A bounded stop rule protects the rest of the simulation.

parts.prompt: Eight minutes remain in the composition section and the draft has a complete route but no checking. Which action has the best priority?

options.text: Add a new unrelated example to make the response longer.
Check task fulfilment and paragraph order first, repair one major evidence gap if present, then use remaining time for sentence boundaries and conventions.
Rewrite the opening repeatedly for a more dramatic first line.
Count every word before checking whether the prompt was answered.

choice_rationales.A: New irrelevant material risks focus and completion.
choice_rationales.B: This follows the highest-impact revision order under limited time.
choice_rationales.C: Opening polish cannot outrank whole-response accuracy.
choice_rationales.D: Task fulfilment matters more than an exact count during final revision.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Final checking should protect meaning and structure before surface polish.

parts.prompt: Which session note indicates contamination rather than a recoverable interruption?

options.text: Browser froze for four minutes; the saved attempt resumed without discussion.
A fire alarm paused the run; start and restart times were recorded.
During the pause, a parent explained the harder reading passage before the learner resumed.
The device restarted; no answers were changed while it was unavailable.

choice_rationales.A: This is a documented technical interruption without help.
choice_rationales.B: This is an external interruption with an audit record.
choice_rationales.C: The explanation adds assistance and changes the performance evidence.
choice_rationales.D: This is a recoverable technical event if documented.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Assistance with test content contaminates the attempt even when an interruption was genuine.

parts.prompt: A learner's reading result improved after reviewing the exact same passages twice. What conclusion is defensible?

options.text: The improvement proves full transfer to unseen reading.
The result may include passage recall; use fresh comparable passages before claiming transferable improvement.
The score guarantees scholarship admission.
No further reading practice is needed.

choice_rationales.B: This recognises the recall confound and specifies the needed evidence.
choice_rationales.C: The simulation is not an admission predictor.
choice_rationales.D: One repeated result does not establish readiness.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Matched unseen material is required before interpreting improvement as transfer.
